blocks.t: Collar details - double collar moment joints

Plates 12 mm (cap) and 12 mm (shelf), A36. Strip beyond the column: 95 mm where a beam laps (L_lap 80 + gap 15), 30 mm at the building edge. Joint classes from the project; beams on each side from the ETABS model. Sides are global: W = -X, N = +Y, E = +X, S = -Y.
